item.title: From Coding Agents to Loop Engineering: Using Knowledge Graphs to Build Better AI Engineering Systems
item.description: Most AI coding setups still look suspiciously like a faster version of the way we have always developed software. A developer asks for a change, an AI model explores some files, writes some code, perhaps runs a few tests, and returns the result. Add more specialised agents and the flow can become more sophisticated — an architect creates a plan, an explorer inspects the repository, a developer implements the change and a reviewer checks the result — but it is still essentially a pipeline.
